hero.subtitle: Glide through tranquil emerald mangrove channels, Balathiruthi backwaters, and sunlit river bends with certified local river guides.

instagram.alt: Sunrise kayaking through Kadalundi mangrove tunnels at 6:00 AM
instagram.caption: 6:00 AM on the Kadalundi River—mirror-still water, rising mist, and the soft rhythm of paddles welcoming the morning sun. 🌅🛶

instagram.alt: Paddler in life jacket kayaking on Kadalundi emerald backwaters
instagram.caption: Life jackets clipped, paddles dipped, smiles wide! First-time paddlers mastering their stroke on today’s guided mangrove drift. 🦺🌿

instagram.alt: Kayak bow gliding through Kadalundi green mangrove canal
instagram.caption: Bow-view through our favorite shaded Kadalundi mangrove corridor. Cool breeze, overhanging trees, and pure calm. 🌿✨

instagram.alt: Kayakers paddling on calm Kadalundi river at golden sunset
instagram.caption: Golden hour reflections across Kadalundi estuary. Join our 4:30 PM Sunset Paddle for views like this. 🌇🛶

instagram.alt: Yellow kayak floating on crystal clear calm mangrove waters in Balathiruthi
instagram.caption: Crystal-clear mangrove stretches where you can watch peaceful bio-life right beneath your hull. 💧🛶

instagram.alt: Paddlers kayaking past lush Kadalundi riverbanks
instagram.caption: Weekend crew exploring the scenic mangrove channels of Kadalundi. Small groups, big memories! 🙌🌿
